b2-dominicana-01.title: Communicative Challenge: A Lake Below Sea Level
b2-dominicana-01.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos are watching a documentary about the Dominican Republic, and he asks which place surprised you most.
b2-dominicana-01.prompt: Tell Carlos about the lake that surprised you, using a relative clause.
cues: Say that it is a salt lake and that it is below sea level
b2-dominicana-01.target: El lago Enriquillo, que es de agua salada, está bajo el nivel del mar.
b2-dominicana-01.english: Lake Enriquillo, which is a salt lake, is below sea level.
b2-dominicana-01.canDo: I can describe a mountain, a bay or a lake with a relative clause (*que*, *quien*).

b2-dominicana-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Who Founded Santo Domingo
b2-dominicana-02.scenario: You are Carlos. You are planning a trip with Meg and reading about the colonial city of Santo Domingo, and she asks who founded it.
b2-dominicana-02.prompt: Tell Meg who founded Santo Domingo.
cues: Say that the city was founded
b2-dominicana-02.target: Santo Domingo fue fundada por Bartolomé Colón.
b2-dominicana-02.english: Santo Domingo was founded by Bartolomé Colón.
b2-dominicana-02.canDo: I can say who founded, built or created something with *fue* / *fueron* + participle.

b2-dominicana-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Bachata Goes Round the World
b2-dominicana-03.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos are listening to a podcast about Dominican music, and he asks what happened to bachata after 1990.
b2-dominicana-03.prompt: Tell Carlos how bachata changed after 1990.
cues: Say that it became popular in many countries
b2-dominicana-03.target: La bachata se volvió popular en muchos países después de 1990.
b2-dominicana-03.english: Bachata became popular in many countries after 1990.
b2-dominicana-03.canDo: I can say how something changed with *ponerse*, *volverse*, *hacerse* or *quedarse*.

b2-dominicana-04.title: Communicative Challenge: What Historians Say About 1937
b2-dominicana-04.scenario: You are Carlos. You are reading an article about the border between the Dominican Republic and Haiti, and Meg asks about the number of deaths in 1937.
b2-dominicana-04.prompt: Tell Meg what the historians say about the number of deaths in 1937.
cues: Say that the number is still debated
b2-dominicana-04.target: Según los historiadores, la cifra de muertos de 1937 se discute todavía.
b2-dominicana-04.english: According to historians, the number of deaths in 1937 is still debated.
b2-dominicana-04.canDo: I can say who reports or judges something with *según* and *explica que*.

b2-dominicana-05.title: Communicative Challenge: If the Grandparents Had Stayed
b2-dominicana-05.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos are reading about Dominican families in New York, and he asks what you think about their story.
b2-dominicana-05.prompt: Imagine how a family's life would be different if their grandparents had not emigrated.
cues: Say that the grandparents did not emigrate (as an imagined past)
Say where the family would live today
b2-dominicana-05.target: Si sus abuelos no hubieran emigrado, hoy ellos vivirían en la isla.
b2-dominicana-05.english: If their grandparents had not emigrated, they would live on the island today.
b2-dominicana-05.canDo: I can say what would be different today if a past choice had been different.

b2-dominicana-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: A Park to Visit
b2-dominicana-consolidation.scenario: You are Carlos. After the unit on the Dominican Republic, Meg asks which place you would most like to visit.
b2-dominicana-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg which park you would like to visit and what it protects.
b2-dominicana-consolidation.target: Los Haitises es un parque que protege manglares y colinas de roca caliza.
b2-dominicana-consolidation.english: Los Haitises is a park that protects mangroves and limestone hills.
b2-dominicana-consolidation.canDo: I can describe a place or a thing with a relative clause (*que*, *quien*).
